## 2. REST API — `src/lib/api.ts` (full contents)

```1:35:src/lib/api.ts
import axios from 'axios'
import { getToken, refreshToken, login } from '@/lib/keycloak'

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL,
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
})

api.interceptors.request.use(async (config) => {
  try {
    await refreshToken()
  } catch {
    // Token refresh failed — will attempt with existing token or redirect to login
  }

  const token = getToken()
  if (token) {
    config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`
  }
  return config
})

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  async (error) => {
    if (error.response?.status === 401) {
      await login()
    }
    return Promise.reject(error)
  },
)

export default api
```

A single Axios instance is exported. It auto-injects a Keycloak Bearer token on every request (refreshing first), and auto-redirects to Keycloak login on 401 responses.

**Known API endpoints used across pages:**
| Method | Endpoint | Used for |
|--------|----------|----------|
| `GET` | `/settings/repos` | Fetch all repo settings |
| `PUT` | `/settings/repos/:workspace/:repo` | Save repo settings |
| `GET` | `/settings/hooks` | Fetch automation hooks |
| `GET/PUT` | `/settings/prompts` | Fetch/save prompt templates |
| `GET` | `/upgrades/latest-versions` | Get latest archetype versions |
| `POST` | `/upgrades/check/:workspace/:repo` | Trigger upgrade check |
| `GET` | `/metrics/quality-reports/:workspace/:repo/:branch` | Latest quality report |
| `GET` | `/metrics/quality-reports/:workspace/:repo/:branch/history` | Historical quality reports |
| `POST` | `/metrics/quality-reports/:workspace/:repo/:branch` | Trigger quality report job |
| `GET` | `/plans` | List execution plans |
| `GET/POST` | `/jobs` | List jobs / create new job |
| `GET` | `/jobs/:id` | Get job detail |


The type domains are:
- **Jobs**: `JobStatus`, `JobType`, `JobStatusResponse`, `RunFixRequest`, `ReviewPrRequest`, `GenerateTestsRequest`, `RejectRequest`
- **Repo Settings**: `RepoSettings`
- **Automation Hooks**: `AutomationHook`
- **Prompt Templates**: `PromptTemplate`
- **Execution Plans**: `PlanStatus`, `PlanStep`, `PlanPhase`, `ExecutionPlan`
- **Quality Reports**: `CoverageSection`, `LinterSection`, `QualityReport`
- **AI Stats**: `AiCallSummary`, `AiCallDailyStat`, `AiCallRecord`
- **Review Metrics**: `ReviewMetrics`
- **Upgrades**: `LatestVersionsResponse` (alias for `Record<string, string>`)
- **Memory**: `MemoryEntry`

## 4. Routing Setup — `src/main.tsx`

The router uses **TanStack Router v1** with a flat, code-defined route tree (no file-based routing). All routes are registered in `main.tsx`:

```77:194:src/main.tsx
const rootRoute = createRootRouteWithContext<object>()({
  component: RootComponent,
})

const layoutRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute,
  id: 'layout',
  component: MainLayout,
})
// ... all page routes nest under layoutRoute
```

**Full route table:**

| Path | Component | Notes |
|------|-----------|-------|
| `/` | `Dashboard` | |
| `/jobs` | `Jobs` | |
| `/jobs/new` | `NewJob` | |
| `/jobs/$id` | `JobDetail` | Dynamic param |
| `/plans` | `Plans` | |
| `/plans/new` | `NewPlan` | |
| `/plans/$id` | `PlanDetail` | Dynamic param |
| `/settings/repos` | `RepoSettingsPage` | |
| `/settings/hooks` | `HooksPage` | |
| `/settings/prompts` | `PromptsPage` | |
| `/metrics/quality` | `QualityReportsPage` | |
| `/metrics/reviews` | `ReviewMetricsPage` | |
| `/stats` | `AiStatsPage` | |
| `/access-denied` | `AccessDenied` | Outside `layoutRoute` |

All pages except `/access-denied` are children of `layoutRoute` (which renders `MainLayout`). `RootComponent` handles Keycloak initialization and redirects to `/access-denied` if not authenticated.

## 5. Navigation/Menu Config — `src/config/applicationMenu.tsx` (full contents)

```1:130:src/config/applicationMenu.tsx
import {
  LayoutDashboard, Wrench, Settings, GitBranch, BarChart3, ChevronDown,
} from 'lucide-react'

export interface NavigationMenuItem {
  id: string
  label: string
  icon?: React.ReactNode
  path?: string
  onClick?: () => void
  isActive?: boolean
  children?: NavigationMenuItem[]
  type?: 'item' | 'section' | 'parent'
  sectionLabel?: string
}

export function ApplicationMenuItems(
  navigate: (opts: { to: string }) => void,
  currentPath: string,
  onNavigate?: () => void,
): NavigationMenuItem[] { ... }
```

The menu structure is:
- **Dashboard** (`/`) — `type: 'item'`
- **Jobs** (`/jobs`) — `type: 'item'`
- **Plans** (`/plans`) — `type: 'item'`
- **Metrics** — `type: 'parent'` (collapsible group)
  - Quality Reports (`/metrics/quality`)
  - Review Metrics (`/metrics/reviews`)
  - AI Stats (`/stats`)
- **Settings** — `type: 'parent'` (collapsible group)
  - Repositories (`/settings/repos`)
  - Hooks (`/settings/hooks`)
  - Prompts (`/settings/prompts`)

`isActive` is computed from `currentPath` (exact match or `startsWith`). Navigation is done via the injected `navigate` callback from TanStack Router.

---

## 6. Settings-Related Pages

Three pages exist under `/settings/*`:

- **`RepoSettings.tsx`** (`/settings/repos`) — table of repos with toggles for feature flags; clicking a row opens an inline modal editor (`RepoEditor`) using `useMutation` for `PUT /settings/repos/:workspace/:repo`.
- **`Hooks.tsx`** (`/settings/hooks`) — manages `AutomationHook` objects.
- **`Prompts.tsx`** (`/settings/prompts`) — manages `PromptTemplate` objects.

---

## 7. SideBar Component Structure

```1:98:src/components/layout/SideBar.tsx
export function SideBar({ user, isMobileExpanded = false, onNavigate }: SideBarProps) {
```

- Collapses to `w-[58px]` on desktop, expands to `w-56` on hover (`isHovered` state) or when `isMobileExpanded=true`.
- **Top section**: Logo image + "Code Agent" text label (shown only when expanded), links to `/`.
- **Middle section**: `<Menu>` component fed with `ApplicationMenuItems(navigate, currentPath, onNavigate)`.
- **Bottom section**: User avatar (initials), username, email, and a `LogOut` button (shown when expanded).
- Uses `useRouterState()` to track `currentPath` for active state highlighting.

The `Menu` / `MenuItem` components in `src/components/navigation/menu/Menu.tsx` handle two item types:
- **`parent`**: renders a collapsible button with `ChevronDown`; children render indented with a left border line.
- **`item`**: renders a plain button that calls `item.onClick`.

Active items use `bg-[var(--color-navigation-menu-item-active)]`; hovered items use `hover:bg-[var(--color-navigation-menu-item-hover-background)]`.

---

## 8. Page Pattern Summary — `QualityReports.tsx`

Every page follows this consistent pattern:

**Structure:**
```tsx
export default function SomePage() {
  // 1. Local state (selected row, modal open, etc.)
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<...>(null)

  // 2. Data fetching with TanStack Query
  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery({ queryKey: [...], queryFn: () => api.get(...).then(r => r.data) })

  // 3. Mutations for actions
  const mutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: () => api.post(...), onSuccess: (data) => navigate(...) })

  // 4. Render
  return (
    <main>
      <PageHeader title="..." subtitle="..." actions={<button>...</button>} />

      {/* Card-wrapped table */}
      <div className="bg-[var(--color-cards-card-background)] border border-[var(--color-cards-card-stroke)] rounded-[var(--border-radius-card)] overflow-hidden shadow-[0_1px_3px_var(--color-cards-card-drop-shadow)]">
        <table className="w-full text-sm">
          <thead>...</thead>
          <tbody>
            {isLoading
              ? /* skeleton shimmer rows: <div className="h-5 skeleton-shimmer rounded" /> */
              : data.length === 0
              ? /* empty state */
              : data.map(row => <tr onClick={() => setSelected(row)}>...</tr>)
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Optional modal dialog */}
      {selected && <SomeDialog row={selected} onClose={() => setSelected(null)} />}
    </main>
  )
}
```

**Modal dialogs** follow this pattern:
```tsx
<div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4" style={{ background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)' }} onClick={onClose}>
  <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl ... bg-[var(--color-cards-card-background)] ..." onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
    {/* Header with close X button */}
    {/* Body with content */}
    {/* Footer with action buttons */}
  </div>
</div>
```

**CSS conventions** — all colors use CSS custom properties scoped to a design system:
- `var(--color-cards-card-background)` / `var(--color-cards-card-stroke)` — card surfaces
- `var(--color-fonts-font-color-headings/primary/support)` — typography
- `var(--color-buttons-button-primary)` — primary button fill
- `var(--color-tags-success/attention/critical-background)` — status badge colors
- `var(--color-tables-table-row-a/hover)` — table row styling
- `var(--border-radius-card/small/button-small/tag)` — consistent radii

**Badge pattern** — small inline components like `ScoreBadge`, `LinterErrorsBadge`, etc. accept a single metric value, compute a color class (`GREEN`/`ORANGE`/`RED`) from threshold logic, and return a `<span>`.
